title: Per-job durable Print Queue merge snapshots and mandatory PDF artifacts

acceptanceCriteria.description: Concurrent PDF merges retain independent per-job snapshots and generation-fenced artifacts instead of overwriting a singleton.

Four missed 15-second heartbeats derive interrupted/stale status within the 60-second recovery window while the generation fence remains active until its execution lease expires; restart recovery can then resume without a permanent phantom running state.
Every completed PDF chunk and terminal merge snapshot is awaited; a stale generation or failed artifact write cannot publish done.
The DURABLE_PRINT_QUEUE_PDF canary passed in production and the later PS-428 boundary made generation-fenced durable chunks mandatory; the compatibility key now defaults on.
The card-mandated guards, migrated restart/concurrency integration, typecheck, production build, runtime schema guard, and source-of-truth pack pass without live label or customer-data mutation.

canonicalOwners: src/services/print-queue/merge-job-store.ts plus print_queue_merge_jobs per-job snapshot, heartbeat, and generation state
src/services/print-queue-pdf-store.ts plus print_queue_pdf_chunks immutable generation-fenced artifacts

oldOwners.path: API-local detached merge execution and fire-and-forget artifact persistence
oldOwners.delegatesTo: dedicated Print Queue worker with awaited snapshot and chunk owners

sotBypass.details: Routes only validate intent and render backend snapshots. Job claims, heartbeat freshness, recovery, artifact publication, and terminal completion remain in the named backend owners.

evidence.proves: A fresh snapshot remains active, a snapshot older than the shared 60-second heartbeat recovery threshold is visibly stale without releasing its generation, a lease-expired snapshot becomes terminal, and completed snapshots are never reclassified.

evidence.command: npm run test:audit-print-queue-merge-durability && npm run test:ps-256-durable-print-queue-pdf && npm run test:ps-403-print-queue-pdf-chunks
evidence.proves: The route reads requested job IDs, PDF chunks are mandatory and generation-fenced, no fire-and-forget terminal writes remain, and missing durable bytes prevent terminal completion.
A migrated PostgreSQL-compatible fixture persists independent jobs and chunks across a simulated restart, reclaims stale work, advances generation, and preserves completed artifacts.
Fresh claims cannot overlap, two job IDs remain independent, and a stale generation cannot update snapshots, overwrite a chunk, or insert a new artifact.

Injected timeout and non-cooperative execution retain ownership until the original attempt settles, acknowledge cancellation afterward, and permit safe generation-fenced recovery without duplicate publication.

evidence.command: npm run test:ps-256-durable-print-queue-pdf && npm run test:ps-346-print-queue-durable-full-results && npm run test:print-queue-persistence && npm run test:ps-403-print-queue-pdf-chunks
evidence.proves: All four Trello acceptance guard families pass against mandatory durable chunks, full durable results, restart-safe persistence, and bounded high-volume PDF chunking.
